recipe.visualDefinition: A central, oversized blue cylindrical battery cell emitting a bright white glow from its top terminal, set against a dark, stormy sky filled with purple-tinted clouds and white lightning strikes. The battery features a split green and red circular emblem and chrome-effect typography, with a group of figures standing at the base of the cylinder.
coreVisualRelationships: Central battery as the primary vertical anchor
Lightning bolts radiating from the center to the edges
Chrome typography overlapping the central circular emblem
Diagonal banner in the top-left corner creating dynamic tension
coreInvariants: High-contrast airbrushed gradients on the battery surface
Metallic gold and silver horizontal bands on the cylinder
Soft glow effect around the battery and lightning
Symmetrical composition centered on the vertical axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The battery occupies approximately 80% of the vertical height, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white light at the top terminal of the battery.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top light, moves down the chrome lettering, follows the lightning bolts outward, and settles on the figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, atmospheric clouds provide high-contrast negative space for the bright lightning and blue battery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Electric blue for the battery body and purple-grey for the sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for lightning and the top glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red and green in the central circle; yellow in the top-left banner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central objects against a desaturated, dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, italicized sans-serif with sharp geometric angles.
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky strokes with a 3D chrome extrusion effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first and last letters feature elongated horizontal strokes that frame the word
Lightning bolt motifs integrated into the diagonal banner text

anatomy.contrast: Low stroke variance, high lighting contrast

treatment.outline: Dark blue or black thin stroke

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact chrome display text paired with a jagged, energetic secondary display font.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, sharp-edged 80s chrome aesthetic.
Necessary to achieve the specific interlocking chrome look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a large blue battery cell with gold and silver bands, a central red and green circle, and a group of five men in white suits at the base. The background is a dark purple stormy sky with bright white lightning bolts and a glow at the top of the battery.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom chrome 3D lettering across the center of the battery and a diagonal yellow banner in the top-left corner with red jagged text.

verificationChecks: Is the battery the central focus?
Does the chrome text have a 3D metallic effect?
Are the lightning bolts bright white against a dark sky?
Is the top-left banner angled at 45 degrees?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures at the base
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Any existing brand logos or trademarks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome text is legible despite the 3D effect.
Check that the lightning does not obscure the central battery.
Verify the glow at the top terminal is the brightest point.
Confirm the diagonal banner is perfectly straight.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central object + atmospheric weather background + chrome 3D typography + diagonal corner accent.
